source_row.rationale: Pseudoephedrine, a sympathomimetic decongestant, can raise blood pressure and heart rate through its vasoconstrictive and stimulant effects. Clients with hypertension (particularly if poorly controlled) should use caution and consult their provider before use, and alternative decongestant options or non-pharmacologic measures may be preferred.
